body:
Handoff from MMR-38 (`docs/runtime-navigation.md`):
- **Strip navmesh.** The production navmesh covers both periodic strips; every logical cell has two physical images.
- **Seam routes in the validator.** Routes try every image of the target and keep the shortest found path, as `GeneratedMapScene`'s periodic queries do. Land and sea routes cross the seam both ways in the fixture without detour (x = 1200 eastbound, x = 400 westbound).
- **Not done.** The `seamTransition` host checks (world B, two ports) route the port transition across the seam column. The embark action at the seam and party movement across it are yours.
